title: Nice selection of sizes
text: Nice selection of sizes. Had leftovers tonight. Decided to finally open my vented Rubbermaid. Sadly, I cannot inform anyone at this point in regards to being leak proof or easy to clean. I was sent the standard “non vented” Rubbermaid containers. My return window closed 5 months ago!

product_metadata.title: Rubbermaid EasyFindLids Food Storage Containers in Special-Edition Skylight Blue, Chris Loves Julia Designer Series, 42-Piece
features: Created in partnership with Chris Loves Julia, this limited-edition Skylight Blue adds a touch of modern style to any kitchen
Modular and stackable, the EasyFindLids food storage system is designed to make clutter a thing of the past
Snap lids to other lids or bases and nest them all together to free up valuable kitchen space
Vented lid reduces microwave splatter and safely allows steam to escape
Make a little extra when you cook and save food in these freezer-safe containers for weekday meals in minutes
Cleanup's a snap—just pop these containers in the dishwasher, lids and all
Disclaimer: Only 3c, 5c & 7c containers contain vented lid
description: Elevate your food storage game with the modern good looks of Rubbermaid EasyFindLids in Skylight Blue. As part of our Designer Series in partnership with Chris Loves Julia, these food storage containers with lids feature all the great qualities of the EasyFindLids system, now in a special-edition color selected by the interior design influencers. With lids that sp to each other and also to the nestable bases, there'll be no more clutter falling out of cabinets or searching for the right lids. And because they’re from the trusted Rubbermaid brand, these plastic food storage containers were designed with safety and convenience in mind. The lids are vented to prevent splatters and release steam safely in the microwave, plus they’re BPA-free and dishwasher- and freezer-safe. Beautiful and space-saving, the Skylight Blue container set adds style and smart storage to your kitchen.
